item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Square Crop Keeps Whole Sneaker

turns.text: Make this wide photo square for an Instagram post. Keep the whole sneaker in view, and don't stretch it or change anything else.

item.tests: Tests converting a 16:9 photo to square while preserving the complete subject and its proportions.

answer_sheet.Subject to preserve: The entire white sneaker, including the toe and heel.
answer_sheet.Style, text and other edits: Keep the original photo appearance. No added text or other edits.

must_haves: The sneaker is the same white leather sneaker as in the attachment.
The entire sneaker, including toe, heel and sole, remains visible.
The sneaker has natural proportions, without stretching or squeezing.
The retained floor and background match the source photo, with no added text or decorative elements.

turns.text: Make this wide photo square for an Instagram post. Keep the whole sneaker in view, and don't stretch it or change anything else.
turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the edit because your account has insufficient credits, so no image was created.

To get the square version without changing the photo, use a **1:1 canvas with white padding above and below**. Keep the photo centered at its original proportions—don’t use “fill,” which would crop the sneaker.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Make this landscape photo square ONLY by expanding the canvas with equal solid white padding above and below the original photograph. Preserve the ENTIRE original photo unchanged centered in the square, including the full sneaker, all background objects, tabletop, shadows, colors, texture and original composition. Do not crop any part of the original photograph. Do not stretch, distort, retouch, redraw, restyle, remove or add objects. Keep the original photograph's aspect ratio and proportions exactly. This is a simple square-canvas padding operation, not an image redesign. White letterbox bands at top and bottom only; original photograph spans full square width.
